Do not eat here!
Feb 2023 • Friends
The breakfast area is an absolute disaster. The vacant lot next door is full of karaoke singing vagrants lying around doing nothing except yelling at each other. The lane way is full of parked up motorcycles and resembles a building site.
Do not have breakfast here and expect good service or a quiet experience. The staff are mostly interns and have not the slightest idea of hospitality management or service. To say they are clueless would be an understatement - common courtesy is absent, no greeting or even a bye or thankyou - they were just rude and lazy!
The standard has dropped through the floor and I will not be returning!
It is clear to me that the management do not care and are not bothered - the place needs to be turned on its head - good luck and good riddance.

Nice setting shame about the food
Nov 2019 • Business
Firstly, let me start by saying we were part of an exceptionally large group of about 60 pax for a conference dinner so i don't want my negative review to be unfavourably compared to those of regular diners ordering off the menu.

MENU
We had a set menu that included overcooked duck, a particularly rubbery eel salad (yes I do acknowledge eel can be rubbery but shouldn't be to the point of unpleasant), a lotus root soup which was a basic broth with slices of rotus root floating in it, grilled prawns which hadn't been shelled or deveined and a fairly unexciting creme brulee. There were a few other items I can't recall but clearly not memorable either.
Whilst this menu may all sound ok, none of it was unique, spectacularly flavoured or particularly tasty. I am being harsh with this review quite simply because the setting was overlooking the Saigon river in plush gardens and located in a magnificent mansion and it looked like the kind of place frequented by the more elite clientele - the food was just plain ordinary in comparison.

Could be much better
Sep 2019 • Family
We went because we wanted a chilled out breakfast sat looking out onto the river. Unfortunately, they were hosting some event for a business so it was really busy. Problem number 2 is it’s too hot outside without a fan pointing at you (the sun wasn’t even out when we went) and they don’t have enough fans. The inside looked a bit too formal for breakfast so we stayed outside sweating. My husband said the Pho was good. I had the waffles, they were disappointing because they could easily have been better. The actual waffles were good but they were served plain with cream, honey and jam on the side. For that price I would really have expected them to be served topped with fresh fruit (bananas at least) and a caramel sauce or something. The service was fine, just difficult to get someone’s attention as they were so busy. Nice setting, I hope they get more fans and start serving the waffles in a way that reflects the price.
